Name: Herdr Deck
Description: Idle isn't always done: Herdr Deck turns your Herdr workspaces into live Stream Deck keys that show which coding agents are blocked, working, still busy with subagents or background tasks, or waiting on a scheduled loop, and adds keys that send commands, text and key presses to them.
Author: Thomas Rooney

Actions.Name: Herdr Space
Actions.Tooltip: Live tile for a Herdr workspace; press to focus it. Green focused, yellow working, red blocked, blue busy in the background, mauve waiting on a timer. Extra workspaces page via arrow keys.

Actions.Name: New Herdr Space
Actions.Tooltip: Create a new Herdr workspace and focus it. Dims while Herdr is offline.

Actions.Name: Agent Summary
Actions.Tooltip: Counts your workspaces by state; press to jump to the one that needs you most, blocked first.

Actions.Name: Slash Command
Actions.Tooltip: Sends a slash command such as /review to the focused agent or a pinned workspace.

Actions.Name: Send Text
Actions.Tooltip: Types a phrase into the focused agent or a pinned workspace, then presses Enter unless you turn it off.

Actions.Name: Send Keys
Actions.Tooltip: Sends key presses to the focused agent or a pinned workspace; esc by default, to interrupt.

Actions.Name: Cycle
Actions.Tooltip: Each press sends the next value, such as /model opus, then sonnet, then haiku, to the focused agent or a pinned workspace.

Actions.Name: New Tab
Actions.Tooltip: Opens a Herdr tab in the target pane's folder, or a folder you choose, and focuses it.
